 4 hours ago Andoni Iraola makes five changes to the Liverpool starting line-up for tonight’s clash with Fenerbahce.
 By James Carroll
 Previous Next Joe Gomez and Kostas Tsimikas come into the Reds defence for the Champions League league-phase game in Istanbul.
 Elsewhere, there are also starts for Victor Munoz, Rio Ngumoha and Dominik Szoboszlai.
 Liverpool: Alisson, Gomez, Van Dijk, Jacquet, Szoboszlai, Mac Allister, Tsimikas, Munoz, Barcola, Nyoni, Ngumoha.
 Subs: Mamardashvili, Woodman, Kerkez, Wirtz, Isak, Gakpo, Araujo, Chambers, McConnell, Koumas, Danns.
